capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: BMW Canada release: 66 kWh net within 70.2 kWh gross. Carried over from the 2023 eDrive35 (same 70.2 kWh pack, no pack or charging change found; EV Database lists 180 kW / 11 kW for the July 2025+ eDrive35, which supports but does not prove the carry-over).

Estimated: BMW US release: 67 kWh net usable (Canadian release says 66). Conflict between the two BMW releases; EV Database 67.1. Carried over from the 2023 eDrive35 (same 70.2 kWh pack, no pack or charging change found; EV Database lists 180 kW / 11 kW for the July 2025+ eDrive35, which supports but does not prove the carry-over).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: auto-data.net lists Li-NMC for the 70.2 kWh eDrive35; BMW states NMC-811 for the larger i4 pack (same G26 generation, same Gen5 cell family). BMW pages for the eDrive35 do not state chemistry.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: auto-data.net lists 400 V for the eDrive35 pack (EV Database nominal 353 V, still 400 V class).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: BMW US 2022 release describes navigation-triggered automatic battery pre-conditioning for the i4 eDrive40/M50 (83.9 kWh pack, a different pack). No page states it for the eDrive35; carried over as a software feature of the same G26 i4 and iDrive navigation, not a pack figure.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: BMW releases: up to 180 kW. Carried over from the 2023 eDrive35 (same 70.2 kWh pack, no pack or charging change found; EV Database lists 180 kW / 11 kW for the July 2025+ eDrive35, which supports but does not prove the carry-over).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: BMW Canada release: 11 kW AC. Carried over from the 2023 eDrive35 (same 70.2 kWh pack, no pack or charging change found; EV Database lists 180 kW / 11 kW for the July 2025+ eDrive35, which supports but does not prove the carry-over).
